synthetic: Factual Q&A with a single unambiguous correct answer extractable by regex
Arithmetic or unit-conversion problems with exact numeric answers
Yes/No classification tasks with clear boolean ground truth
Short list generation where order does not matter (set equality scoring)
Named-entity extraction from a fixed context snippet

cases.prompt: What is the capital city of France?
Convert 72 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius. Give only the numeric result rounded to one decimal place.

Is the following sentence grammatically correct? Answer only Yes or No.

Sentence: "She go to school every day."
From this sentence extract all proper nouns and list them comma-separated, lowercase: "Marie Curie was born in Warsaw and later moved to Paris to study at the Sorbonne."
Is 127 a prime number? Answer only Yes or No.
Does Python support multiple inheritance? Answer only Yes or No.
cases.note: Models occasionally hedge or say 'it depends' on language-feature questions; we want a crisp Yes.

cases.prompt: What is the output of this Python expression: round(2.675, 2)? Give only the number.
cases.note: Classic IEEE 754 gotcha — models often incorrectly say 2.68.
